lead: We use only part of Greene Middle School. Here’s where classes are, where events happen, and which areas are off-limits.
events: Assemblies, ceremonies, Eid events and graduation are held in the Gym or the MPR (Multi-Purpose Room). The event announcement says which one.
offLimits: The construction zone in the middle of campus
The pool, and the gym except during school events
Fields, tennis courts and other outdoor play areas
Any locked room. If it’s locked, it’s not for us.
allowed: Youth Group students may use the basketball courts during break. Bring your own ball.
